#rom debug
#save after-first-dungeon
# DX Fairy moves (gen_dx_moves.py): A picks Moonblast against a Dragon and it hits; Draining Kiss heals.
# Generated by tools/dxtest/gen_fairy_moves_test.py.
mash START sMainMenu 4 != 0 3000
wait 60
press UP
press A
wait 30
press A
wait 30
press UP
press UP
wait 10
expect *sDxWarp+0xB0 4 == 2
press A
wait 40
expect *sDxWarp+0xB0 4 == 1
press A
mash A gDungeon 4 != 0 1800
wait 600
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoTypes 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoTypes!1 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2 999
# all four known; a Dragon next to the leader
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!0 1 1
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!1 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 361
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!4 1 10
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!8 1 1
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!9 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!10 2 404
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!12 1 10
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!16 1 1
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!17 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!18 2 411
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!20 1 10
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!24 1 1
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!25 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!26 2 362
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!28 1 10
write gDxTestStageTypes 1 15
write gDxTestStageTypes+1 1 0
write gDxTestStageHP 2 0
write gDxTestStageFoe 1 1
write gDxTestStageFoe+1 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate+1 1 0
write gDxTestStage 1 1
waitfor gDxTestStage 1 == 0 900
wait 10
read hp0 **gDxTestStageMon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2
write gDxTestOut+8 2 99
press A
waitfor gDxTestOut+8 2 != 99 120
wait 4
shot 1_moonblast
expect gDxTestOut+8 2 == 362
wait 120
read hp1 **gDxTestStageMon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2
cmpreads hp1 < hp0
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!28 1 == 9
wait 150
# Draining Kiss alone, the leader hurt: it hits and heals the leader
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!0 1 1
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!1 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 404
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!4 1 10
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!8 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!9 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!16 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!17 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!24 1 0
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!25 1 0
write gDxTestStageTypes 1 1
write gDxTestStageTypes+1 1 0
write gDxTestStageHP 2 0
write gDxTestStageFoe 1 1
write gDxTestStageFoe+1 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate+1 1 0
write gDxTestStage 1 1
waitfor gDxTestStage 1 == 0 900
wait 10
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMaxHP 2 999
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2 100
read lhp0 ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2
read fhp0 **gDxTestStageMon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2
write gDxTestOut+8 2 99
press A
waitfor gDxTestOut+8 2 != 99 120
wait 4
shot 2_draining_kiss
expect gDxTestOut+8 2 == 404
wait 120
read fhp1 **gDxTestStageMon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2
read lhp1 ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2
cmpreads fhp1 < fhp0
cmpreads lhp1 > lhp0
shot 3_after
